VI.description: Attaches a VI or a project to Nigel's chat\2C launching the chat first if it is not running - the same two stages as the IDE's "Discuss with Nigel" command\2C but driven over VI Server so that BOTH error results survive.\0A\0AWHY NOT CALL NI'S CALLBACK. LV AI Plugins.lvlib\3Alv_discuss_file_with_nigel.vi does exactly these two stages in a Flat Sequence and is reachable as an AIXML Call - but it returns NOTHING\2C discarding InvokeDiscussVI's error code and message. This helper calls the two packed-library VIs itself instead\3A they are unreachable as AIXML Call targets\2C and reachable by qualified name through Open VI Reference. Measured 2026-09-10\3A both open\2C both report Execution\3AState 1\2C and Ctrl Val.Set accepts all three of InvokeDiscussVI's controls - the string\2C the PATH\2C and the uint32 ENUM\2C which is the one that had to be proven because Ctrl Val.Set type-checks the variant against the control.\0A\0AWHY THE SELECT WITH TWO IDENTICAL INPUTS. NI leaves the launch's error out unwired\2C so its Flat Sequence supplies ORDER and nothing else. Chaining the error here instead would let a failed launch suppress the push\2C which is a behaviour change. So the launch's status gates a Select whose two branches are the same string\3A the value is unchanged\2C the data dependency forces the launch to finish first\2C and the launch error is reported rather than acted on.\0A\0AFile Type takes the literal text VI or PROJECT\2C UPPERCASE - the comparison is case-sensitive and anything else falls through to VI.

Control.description: Absolute path of the .vi or .lvproj to discuss\2C as a string. Converted on the diagram\2C because InvokeDiscussVI's terminal is a path and values reach a generated VI as strings.
The name Nigel shows for the file. NI's own callback passes the file name.
VI or PROJECT\2C uppercase. Empty or unrecognised means VI\2C which is what the IDE's own Discuss command hardcodes.

FreeLabel.comment: NI's two stages over VI Server: the chat is launched first, then the discuss request is pushed and its error read back.

Indicator.description: Which branch the diagram took\2C as the enum's item name. A STRING and not the enum itself\3A an enum indicator was measured coming back EMPTY with errorCode 91 under RunVIAsTopLevel - after the VI had run correctly - so echoing the enum would make every call report an error it did not have. Both Select nodes share one boolean\2C so this text and the enum handed to InvokeDiscussVI cannot disagree.
The error cluster of Launch Nigel Chat.vi\2C flattened. REPORTED\2C not acted on - NI leaves this unwired\2C so a failure here does not stop the push.

InvokeDiscussVI's own indicators after it ran - error code and error message\2C the verdict NI's callback discards. Ctrl Val.Get All returns INDICATORS ONLY\2C measured\2C so this is exactly those two.
This helper's own error chain around the push\2C flattened - the open\2C the three Ctrl Val.Set calls\2C Run VI and the close.
